locationModel: Resolve by executable/window role, menu ancestry, current visible English label, commandId, sibling order, hotkey, current state, and screenshot geometry. commandId values are native KiCad/wxWidgets menu command identifiers, not Windows Automation IDs. Runtime negative control IDs and pixel coordinates are never durable selectors.

verificationPolicy.installed_cli_observed_no_gui: Observed from winget and kicad-cli without starting a graphical application.
verificationPolicy.official_documentation: Name, purpose, or placement is stated by the official KiCad 10.0 English manual.
verificationPolicy.official_action_reference: Action name and optional default hotkey appear in the official action reference; exact menu or toolbar placement may still require a live scan.
verificationPolicy.live_observed: Observed in the running KiCad 10.0.6 English UI using the accessibility tree and visual inspection.
verificationPolicy.documentation_inferred: Grouped from official documentation for semantic lookup; exact label, order, and nesting require a live scan.
verificationPolicy.needs_live_scan: Not verified against the running 10.0.6 English UI. Do not treat hierarchy, order, bounds, or identifiers as authoritative.

identifierPolicy.warning: The repository-local locatorId fields are semantic keys, and live commandId values are KiCad/wxWidgets menu identifiers. Neither is a Windows Automation ID.
